The exact vault runtime hex-string SHA-256 remains 785aabab2906e799636c4b424bb35c04fd2d74bf35b5dff761b492b3f0afb274, preserving the prior functional source correspondence.

Its source ignores round timestamps. At Arc block 26080279 (2026-10-15T10:44:09Z), updatedAt=1792049925 was 11124 seconds before the block, replacing the earlier 70884-second snapshot. Feed proxy and DualAggregator owner remain 0x73877fe34aa2b162430cef680fea268b8ec1c4f1; that authority can replace/configure pricing. Internal vault NAV does not remove borrower-price or cirBTC reserve/custody risk.

branches.fallbackBehavior: Exact deployed Morpho adapter has a single BTC/USD feed and no independent fallback. ChainlinkDataFeedLib checks only nonnegative answer, not timestamp freshness. collateralParameters.note: Immutable market liquidation loan-to-value from Morpho API, not vault utilization or a liquidation execution guarantee.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any external liquidator may repay debt and receive collateral when oracle-valued LTV exceeds LLTV. Actual callability and stressed sale execution on this exact feed were not measured.
branches.backstop: The reviewed code/documentation establishes permissionless incentivized liquidation; no funded exact-market recovery backstop was established.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Morpho losses reduce the adapter claim; VaultV2 accrual realizes reduced realAssets as proportional share-price depreciation. No exact-market funded shutdown recovery or legal priority is established.
